body:
## Purpose

This repository starts clean. The retired `law-history` branch in [`sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws`](https://github.com/sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws/tree/law-history) is not an authoritative historical baseline: it seeded current consolidated texts into a synthetic 2001 state and then generated later commits and tags. Do not import its commit graph, tags, or generated legal texts.

Before implementing historical reconstruction, audit which pipeline mechanics - not outputs or historical claims - can safely be reused.

## Source scope

Review these locations in `sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws`:

- `lovdata-loader/`
- `lovdata-publisher/`
- `.github/workflows/law-history.yml`
- Acquisition, parser, formatter, Git-export, and fixture tests

## Required review matrix

For every candidate component, classify it as **reuse**, **extract after repair**, **rewrite**, or **retire**, with exact code links, dependency boundaries, and rationale:

- Lovdata API acquisition and immutable raw-observation capture
- Release identifiers, manifests, checksums, provenance, and NLOD attribution
- Download idempotency and cache behavior
- Parser tree model and ordered source-token coverage
- Versioned canonical formatter contract
- Reverse/round-trip verifier and fail-closed remainder gate
- Git tree/commit export primitives
- Self-contained GitHub Actions using only the repository `GITHUB_TOKEN` for repository writes
- Fixtures, golden-corpus tests, and regression tests

## Known hazards that must not be inherited

- Weekly cache files can be treated as authoritative source data after the upstream manifest changes.
- `build_history` seeds a historical commit with the current corpus and applies amendments forward.
- Unknown commencement can fall back to publication for an entire act.
- Regulation amendment targets can be dropped by law-only target extraction.
- The current parsed model is non-injective and can reorder mixed list/text structures.
- Token/remainder checks do not prove ordered, nested, lossless coverage and do not fail closed.
- Parser and formatter changes can create corpus-wide false Git diffs.
- The old workflow force-pushes the branch and yearly tags.

## Deliverables

- A component-level reuse decision table with evidence.
- A proposed extraction boundary for shared code, while preserving Git repositories as the products.
- A versioned canonicalization and provenance contract.
- A list of invariants and tests required before any component is reused.
- A migration sequence that imports no synthetic historical output.
- Follow-up implementation issues small enough to test and review independently.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every proposed reuse maps to an exact code path, test, and contract version.
- Legal valid time is separated from observation/knowledge time.
- Every materialization remains traceable to immutable source evidence and a knowledge cutoff.
- Round-trip verification proves ordered structural coverage or fails promotion.
- A fork can run core workflows with only the default `GITHUB_TOKEN`; external archival remains optional.
- No historical state is published as authoritative without an explicit evidence basis.
title: Audit reusable pipeline rigging before implementing history
